A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CausalProfiler research work. All 54 pages, including Appendices A–L, were readable and matched across versions; text comparison and rendered-page checks support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark-verification experiments, SCM-distribution analyses, causal-method evaluations, and scalability measurements in Section 6 and Appendices H, K, and L.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including method-performance results in Tables 1–2 and the additional experiments in Appendices H, K, and L.

M1.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–F retain the same Space of Interest specification, graph and mechanism sampling, data generation, and query sampling and estimation procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same continuous and discrete SCM settings, CausalNF and bnlearn benchmark comparisons, hidden-confounding scenarios, and larger-graph scalability evaluations in Section 6 and Appendices H, K, and L.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: CausalNF, DCM, NCM, and VACA in Table 1; CausalNF and DCM in Table 2; and DeCaFlow additionally in the hidden-confounding condition of Table 20.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols, metrics, sample sizes, graph configurations, preprocessing, and testing procedures are identical in Section 6 and Appendices H, K, and L.

E4.justification: Both retain the same analyses of SCM distributions, mechanism families, limited data, discrete-variable robustness, hidden confounding, and runtime scalability. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: The five-seed method evaluations, reported standard deviations, five-run generator timing measurements, and chi-square testing with Benjamini–Hochberg correction remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results, and reported findings match, including appendix results. For example, Table 1 retains DCM's Linear-Medium mean error of 0.1530, and Table 2 retains CausalNF's 100% failure rate on Disc-L-C2-Unbias.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, formal assumptions, coverage Proposition 5.1 and its Appendix J proof, and complexity derivations in Appendix L.4 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: a configurable synthetic causal benchmark generator with coverage guarantees and transparent assumptions, demonstrated through structured empirical evaluations.

C2.justification: Interpretations of method performance and assumption violations are unchanged. Section 7 and the appendices retain the same qualifications concerning sampling bias, coverage, unsupported settings, and the simulation-to-real gap.

D1.justification: Pseudocode, configuration tables, hardware descriptions, implementation details, and code-access information are unchanged. The new funding acknowledgement adds attribution rather than technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning, and the complete cited-work list are unchanged. References appearing on different pages were relocated by bibliography reflow, not added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Acknowledgements section on page 11 identifying ANR and UKRI funding, and updates the arXiv version/date text on page 1. The remaining prose and scientific section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement shifts the References heading downward and reflows bibliography entries across pages 11–14. All scientific figures, tables, equations, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution on page 11, updates the version/date, and reflows the unchanged bibliography. This provides funding credit but leaves the scientific exposition, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations unchanged, yielding no meaningful overall quality difference.
